public_rationale: The search found major capability gains and public claims that AGI had arrived. The independent benchmark evaluator explicitly declined to call its result AGI, and the AGI Society found the published evidence insufficient. These records do not establish a decisive counterexample, but neither do they establish that scaling can never work. The forecast has no deadline.
limitations: There is no universally accepted AGI test.
Public technical disclosures do not isolate the contribution of scaling.
Failure to establish AGI by the evaluation date cannot support an unlimited negative forecast.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Scaling LLMs will not produce AGI.

statement.excerpt: that LLM scaling would not bring us to AGI
statement.document_title: The bad news: AI is going pretty much as I expected

from_speaker: would not bring us to AGI
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that increasing LLM scale will not by itself produce broadly human-level general intelligence.
A decisive counterexample requires independent evidence of broad general capability and sufficient technical disclosure to attribute its achievement to LLM scaling.
No deadline is supplied. Continued failures, expert skepticism, or achieving AGI through another method cannot establish this universal negative.
criteria.support_condition: A broadly accepted impossibility result applicable to the intended class of scaled LLMs and to human-level general intelligence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independently evaluated system broadly recognized as human-level AGI, achieved through LLM scaling within the intended scope.

evidence.explanation: The independent evaluation reports major progress, including 62.7% with its standard harness and 99.9% with a provider adapter, but explicitly rejects treating the result as proof of AGI. This is material progress without a decisive counterexample.
The assessment examines public claims that AGI had arrived and finds the available demonstrations insufficient. It documents a disputed achievement claim, not proof that scaling can never succeed.

The developer attributes the model to several research areas. The disclosure does not isolate increasing LLM scale as the sufficient cause of its capabilities; availability is conservatively dated to the page's September update.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated, independently validated AGI demonstration with technical evidence that LLM scaling produced it, or an accepted impossibility result covering the specified route. Clarifying the meaning of scaling would reduce scope disputes.
